title: Pivoting Data
instructions: Using `tidyr`, convert a long-format data frame to wide format using `pivot_wider()`. The data has columns `country`, `year`, and `gdp`. Pivot so each year becomes a column.
starterCode:
library(tidyr)

gdp_long <- data.frame(
  country = c("Norway", "Norway", "Sweden", "Sweden"),
  year = c(2022, 2023, 2022, 2023),
  gdp = c(579.3, 601.2, 585.9, 597.1)
)

gdp_wide <- gdp_long |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ___, values_from = ___)
print(gdp_wide)
